study.title: Real-Time Weed Segmentation in Tobacco Crops Utilizing Deep Learning on a Jetson Nano
study.venue: 2024 International Conference on Engineering & Computing Technologies (ICECT)

segmentation.domain: weed vs tobacco crop vs background
segmentation.best_model: U-Net-MobileNetV2 (cropped ~0.5 m GSD setup): accuracy 94%, max IoU 0.85; real-time on Jetson Nano

dataset.name: Tobacco Aerial Dataset (Mardan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan)
dataset.note: Public dataset: DJI Mavic Mini drone images of 8 tobacco fields, Mardan, KPK, Pakistan; altitude 4 m; tobacco plants 15-40 days old; 1920x1080 px resized to 480x352; MATLAB Image Labeler annotation into 3 classes (background, tobacco crop, weed) as 8-bit labels 0/1/2; model input 224x224x3; 80/20 train-test split. Phase-2 simulation cropped images to simulate ~0.5 m altitude. Real-time validation at different site in Mansehra District, Pakistan.

segmentation.backbone: MobileNetV2 (encoder, depthwise-separable + inverted residuals) + U-Net decoder with skip connections

mIoU.quote: mean intersection over union value of 0.851 (abstract); simulation: maximum IoU reached 0.85 (0.54 at 4 m altitude)
mIoU.ambiguity: Abstract states mIoU 0.851/96% accuracy; text section reports max IoU 0.85 and 94% accuracy for the cropped (~0.5 m) setup. Two simulation phases: 4 m altitude accuracy 79.8%, IoU 0.54.

PA.quote: performance ... significantly improved, with an accuracy of 94% (abstract: 96% accuracy)
PA.ambiguity: Abstract claims 96%; results section states 94% for cropped (~0.5 m) setup and 79.8% for original 4 m altitude setup.

crop_F1.ambiguity: Per-class metrics not reported; model output described as binary weed/background mask.

edge.framework: PyTorch + ONNX Runtime on Jetson Nano (CUDA-accelerated)

fps.ambiguity: Not reported directly; per-frame latency implies ~3.7 fps (derived from 271.29 ms combined).

latency_ms.quote: The combined duration of the model and real-time inference is observed to be 271.29milliseconds (Fig. 11)
latency_ms.ambiguity: EDGE deployment: Jetson Nano + USB camera + power bank mounted on a drone, real-time validation in tobacco fields, Mansehra, Pakistan. Duration = combined model + real-time inference per frame; composition not detailed.

power_w.ambiguity: Power not measured (power bank used in mobile setup).

issues: Real edge deployment (Jetson Nano) with on-drone real-time validation => edge.reported TRUE.
Accuracy/mIoU discrepancy: abstract 96%/0.851 vs results text 94%/0.85 vs first phase 79.8%/0.54 (altitude-dependent).
Annotation is 3-class but model output described as binary weed mask; mIoU presumably 3-class.
Fig. 5/7 metric curves (accuracy/loss/mIoU) figure-only; numeric maxima quoted in text.
